question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
-- Verify row count
WITH max_composition AS (
    SELECT 
        interest_id,
        MAX(composition) AS max_comp
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE composition IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY interest_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        im.interest_id,
        im.month_year,
        im.composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY im.composition DESC) AS rn_asc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY im.composition ASC) AS rn_desc
    FROM interest_metrics im
    JOIN max_composition mc ON im.interest_id = mc.interest_id AND im.composition = mc.max_comp
    JOIN interest_map imap ON im.interest_id = imap.id
)
SELECT 
    month_year AS time,
    imap.interest_name,
    composition
FROM ranked r
JOIN interest_map imap ON r.interest_id = imap.id
WHERE rn_asc <= 10 OR rn_desc <= 10
ORDER BY composition DESC
